---
# Positive control for the watermark. A phrase, not a single word, because the
# single-word case is the one that works by accident.
#
# Two failures this catches. `place` hands the text the whole page to lay out
# in, so anything with a space in it wrapped to two stacked lines set at the
# size computed for one — the box around it at its measured width is what
# stops that. And the fit is on the ROTATED bounding box: fitting the
# unrotated width instead ran the word off both corners, because a line set at
# angle t is w*cos(t) + h*sin(t) across and the second term is not small when
# the letters are a foot tall.
#
# CI can only prove the watermark is THERE. Rotated text comes back out of
# pdftotext as loose glyphs in scrambled order, and poppler clamps every
# reported bounding box to the page — an out-of-bounds check on the broken
# fit returned zero, so there is no cheap assertion that the word stays on
# the paper or stays on one line. Both were checked by looking at the render
# and are not guarded here; a change to the fit needs the same eyeball.
title: "Watermark fixture"
format:
  sciposter-typst:
    poster:
      size: "48x36"
      columns: 2
      watermark: "DO NOT CIRCULATE"
---
